operator_checklist.item: Confirm Round118 readiness decision is not NO-GO
Confirm explicit operator approval for real production persistence
Confirm runtime_mapping_enabled default remains false before activation patch
Confirm enforcement_enabled default remains false before activation patch
Confirm broader validation is passed or explicitly accepted as partial by operator
Confirm no forbidden binary/operator artifacts are staged

risk_matrix.mitigation: resolve or explicitly waive blocked/partial validation before real persistence
risk_matrix.risk: broader pytest remains blocked or partial

risk_matrix.mitigation: require a separate approval token/package and separate activation patch
risk_matrix.risk: production persistence could be applied without an explicit operator decision

risk_matrix.mitigation: pre-activation check must verify both defaults false until the explicit activation patch
risk_matrix.risk: runtime_mapping_enabled or enforcement_enabled defaults could drift true

risk_matrix.mitigation: scan changed files and artifact roots before PR; keep artifacts external
risk_matrix.risk: binary vector, seed subset, zip/part, or operator artifact could enter the PR

risk_matrix.mitigation: preserve AGP anchored generation and keep lexical mapping evidence separate from anchors
risk_matrix.risk: lexical persistence could be mistaken for AGP anchor authority
